recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The core value set is already correct, and the commit narrowly fixes the remaining in-build example inconsistency; no core follow-up is needed unless a broader non-core package audit is desired.
issue_request: FHIR-23866 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked to replace inactive SNOMED CT laterality value set concepts 419161000 Unilateral left and 419465000 Unilateral right with active concepts 7771000 Left and 24028007 Right.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-23866 commit was found. Current source history shows related FHIR-29810/FHIR-32889 corrections for the same inactive left/right code pair in BodyStructure relative-location terminology, and FHIR-45256a later introduced the current BodyStructure laterality value set with 7771000 and 24028007 already in place.
additional_context: FHIR-31571 is a duplicate report of the same inactive bodysite-laterality concepts. FHIR-23866 comments and the linked Zulip terminology thread explain that ImagingStudy moved away from a FHIR-managed bodysite-laterality value set toward DICOM canonical value sets. In current core, BodyStructure is active and BodyStructure.includedStructure.laterality is bound to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/bodystructure-laterality, whose source already uses the active replacement codes.
reconciliation: Changed source/bodystructure/bodystructure-example.xml and source/bodystructure/bodystructure-example-skin-patch.xml from SNOMED CT 419161000 Unilateral left to 7771000 Left. This removes the remaining current-source occurrences of the inactive seed concept while leaving the already-correct value set unchanged.
